landing.methodTitle: Why does the Norwegian method produce so many champions?
landing.methodIntro: Where classical plans pile up hard sessions until injury, the Norwegian method accumulates time under the lactate threshold — much more quality, far less wear. Nordic Run translates this method for runners without a lactate lab or a personal coach — at their level, without overshooting.
landing.m1Body: Most of the quality sits just under the lactate threshold (LT1-LT2, ~2-3 mmol/L). You bank useful intensity without digging fatigue. Double-threshold — two sessions the same day — only appears once your physiology is ready, much later.
landing.m2Body: Paces come from the Jack Daniels table, updated whenever you race. No more guessing — and no more redlining.
landing.m3Body: High fatigue, a niggle, late luteal phase, a 40-min slot only: your session re-adapts before you lace up.

landing.faqTitle: What you want to know before starting.
landing.faq1q: I run 25 km a week — is the Norwegian method really for me?
landing.faq1a: Yes. The core of the method — controlled threshold work, progressive volume, dosed intensity — applies at every level. Nordic Run grows your volume very progressively (8% per week max, deload week every 4th cycle). Double-threshold itself is only introduced when your physiology can absorb it — months later, and only if it fits your profile.
landing.faq2q: How is this different from a ChatGPT plan?
landing.faq2a: ChatGPT gives you a frozen plan that knows nothing about you tomorrow. Nordic Run calibrates paces to your exact VDOT, remembers your last 90 days of load, and lowers intensity automatically when cumulative fatigue data calls for it. A protocol, not a chatbot answer.
landing.faq3q: What if I get pregnant / injured / take a long break?
landing.faq3a: Pause mode from the profile. Your data and VDOT are kept. When you return, the plan restarts with a progressive return-to-running phase rather than where you stopped.
landing.faq4a: Not yet. Strava and Garmin Connect sync are on the Q2 roadmap. For now you log workouts manually (30 seconds each).
landing.faq5q: Who designed the protocol you use?
landing.faq5a: Our engine is based on the published work of Arturo Casado and Thomas Haugen on lactate-guided training, combined with Jack Daniels' Running Formula for pace zones. Everything is open and documented.
